meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:
Finding a reliable pair of running shoes under ₹3000 in India is entirely doable, especially if you look out for online sales on platforms like Amazon, Myntra, or brand websites.[www.mensxp.com](https://www.mensxp.com/fashion/shoes/47756-these-are-the-best-running-shoes-under-rs-3000-for-men-who-are-all-for-fitness.html#:~:text=Be%20it%20their%20swanky%20and,%C2%A9%20Amazon)

Here are some of the best-rated options and trusted brands known for combining durability, comfort, and performance within a sub-₹3000 budget:

### 1. Top Budget Recommendations

* **Adidas (Entry-Level Performance Series)**
  *   * *Models to look for:* **Adidas Runfalcon series** (like Runfalcon 5) or select colorways of the **Adidas Switch Run**.
  * *Why buy:* They offer solid EVA midsole cushioning, great heel stability, and breathable mesh uppers. Perfect for beginners, gym workouts, and short daily runs.
* **Campus (Yoga Max / Nitro Series)**
  *   * *Models to look for:* Campus running shoes featuring **Yoga Max** or **Nitro-infused** insoles.
  * *Why buy:* Campus is a homegrown favorite that punches well above its weight class. You get fantastic step-in comfort, soft cushioning, and trendy designs, often priced comfortably between ₹1,500 and ₹2,500.
* **Red Tape (Flow+ / Sports Series)[www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/sports-shoes-under-3000#:~:text=Men%20Running%20Shoes-,Campus%20Women%20Running%20Shoes,AVANT%20Men%20Thrust%20Running%20Shoes)**
  *   * *Models to look for:* Red Tape Flow+ running shoes.
  * *Why buy:* They offer surprisingly good build quality for the price, featuring soft insoles, nice spring/energy return in the midsole, and good outsole grip.
* **Puma & Asics (Entry-Level / Sale Picks)**
  *   * *Models to look for:* Entry-level Puma running shoes or entry Asics models when on discount.
  * *Why buy:* While some core performance models cross ₹3,000, e-commerce sales frequently drop basic Puma and select Asics running shoes right into the ₹2,000–₹3,000 bracket, giving you high-end brand durability.

---

### Quick Buying Tips for Budget Running Shoes

1.  **Check the Sole:** Look for rubber pods on the outsole rather than pure foam. Pure foam bottoms wear out quickly on Indian asphalt roads.
2.  **Cushioning vs. Stability:** If you have flat feet or overpronate, look for shoes with a slightly firmer midsole and a reinforced heel counter for support.
3.  **Size Matters:** Running shoes usually require going **half a size up** from your standard casual shoe size to account for foot swelling and toe room during runs.

Would you prefer recommendations geared more towards outdoor road running, gym training, or daily casual walking?
